links.outcome: ESM2 variant predictor performance (AUROC, AUPR) under targeted soft prompt adversarial attacks
links.effect: ESM2 is sensitive to targeted soft prompt attacks, with measurable performance degradation; exact figures are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Using SAGE, we find that even state-of-the-art GFMs like ESM2 are sensitive to targeted soft prompt attacks, resulting in measurable performance degradation.

unlisted_practices: Agentic automated risk auditing of embedding-space robustness of genomic foundation models via soft prompt perturbations and checkpoint monitoring, with LLM-generated narrative reports

screen.reason: Empirically tests an automated agentic risk auditing framework (SAGE) to evaluate adversarial soft prompt attack vulnerabilities in genomic foundation models used for clinical variant prediction.

primary.practice: agentic risk auditing / adversarial red teaming
